request: Create a polished third-person 3D tropical jungle adventure game for Windows and Android. The player controls a monkey, explores a jungle, collects bananas, avoids environmental hazards, and reaches a final destination. The game should support low-end hardware and use an efficient rendering approach.
source_label_note: Built from the offline fixture payload, not from a live provider response.

design.request: Jungle Banana Run A short third-person jungle collection level for Windows and Android. Tropical jungle biome with a defined trail Cliffs, river and foliage dressing Directional sunlight with a warm ambient fill Explore the jungle trail Collect bananas to fill the objective counter Avoid hazard volumes and respawn at the last checkpoint Reach the destination zone to complete the level

environment_requirements: Tropical jungle biome with a defined trail
Directional sunlight with a warm ambient fill
character_requirements: Player character described by the approved specification

performance_targets.notes: Keep draw calls bounded and reuse materials.

asset_requirements: Monkey character mesh with a 24-bone rig and idle/walk/run/jump animations
Jungle terrain tiles, tree and bush props, river plane and rock clusters
Banana prop with a stylized material
PBR base color and roughness textures for terrain and props
HUD font, banana icon and menu panel
technical_constraints: Procedural Blender assets are not AI-generated assets.
No paid provider may be used under free-only policy.
testing_requirements: Collecting a banana increments the HUD counter within 1 frame
The player reaches the destination zone and the level completes within 10 seconds of arrival
Frame rate stays at or above 60 fps for 30 seconds on the reference hardware
All 10 bananas can be collected in one run

what_must_be_approved: Engine, dimension, art direction and scope
Any future asset generation or build run
